neighbours.label: Earth's yearly motion past a comet or the Sun ('Earth passes through the tail of the comet'; guess)
fire: About this time each year, Earth passes through the debris of a comet.
Every August the Earth passes through the trail of Swift-Tuttle.
In November the planet passes through the dust of an old comet.
This week Earth passes through a stream of small particles.
Each year, our planet passes through the tail of Halley's comet.
The meteors appear when Earth passes through the dust cloud.
Twice a year Earth crosses the orbit of the comet.
The shower peaks as Earth passes through the densest part.
quiet: About this time each year, the bus passes through the old town.
Every August the train passes through the valley on time.
In November the parade passes through the center of the city.
This week the river passes through a stretch of farmland.
Each year, our team passes through the same small village.
The geese appear when the farmer passes through the field.
Twice a year the mail van crosses the bridge.
The road dips as it passes through the narrow gap.
